agent_explanation: Shrunk fixed-time-like scenario under actuated control shows EW yellow lasting only 3s (steps 202-204) before all-red at 205, violating yellow_seconds=5. With actuated=true the controller truncates yellow early, likely due to max_wait/recall or gap-out logic interrupting yellow. Disabling actuated (fixed-time) removes the truncation and eliminates the violation.
